project.title: NASA Psyche Mission: AR/WebXR for Public Engagement—CERNN: Lore and Mythology Experience

section-description.title: Project Overview
section-description.description: The project outlines an interactive Augmented Reality (AR) experience designed to educate the general public about NASA’s Psyche mission by blending real-world astronomical discovery with its namesake Greek mythology.

item.detail: Likened to a chrysalis in Greek myth, the asteroid represents a planetary "soul" whose failure to become a full planet mirrors the goddess Psyche falling into a deep sleep.
The spacecraft's butterfly-like solar panels symbolize the "breath of life," framing its scientific mission as a way to grant the asteroid immortality.
Users play as an 1852 astronomer using an interactive AR telescope to discover the asteroid before viewing rotatable 3D videos that explain its mythological connections.
Users watch the 2023 spacecraft launch and travel through space while an animated winged overlay connects the modern scientific journey to the goddess's myth.
The primary challenge is designing and building the complex 3D AR models required for the historical telescope, the mythological figures, and the rocket launch.
The highly inclusive app will feature intuitive gesture controls, written text, full audio descriptions, and a dedicated audio-only mode for visually impaired users.

section-description.title: Core Functional Requirements
section-description.description: Refined Sponsor requirements to the creation of a two-phase, gamified mythological experience about the Psyche asteroid and spacecraft that integrates interactive discovery mechanics, lore-driven vector graphics, and comprehensive UI/UX designs.

item.detail: The Asteroid Mythos Phase gamifies the historical discovery by having users search for the asteroid within a timed Skybox using a virtual telescope.
A lore section follows that uses glowing, constellation-style vector images to connect the asteroid's nature to a chrysalis and the sleeping goddess Psyche.
The Spacecraft Mythos Phase covers the modern mission by displaying the spacecraft's launch and an arrival timer.
Butterfly vector graphics to symbolize the "Breath of Life" and framing the scientific documentation as a way for the goddess to achieve immortality.
Designed and delivered comprehensive UI mockups for the launch interface, settings menu, interactive dialog boxes, and help screens to establish the visual language and user flow.
